issues.quote: Total assets stood at six hundred twenty-four point nine million dollars
issues.problem: Wrong unit. Amazon's total assets at the end of fiscal 2024 were about $624.9 billion, not million.

data.summary: The analysis is not accurate because of one unit error. Total assets were about $624.9 billion, but the text says "million." The other figures agree with Amazon's reported FY2024 results as far as I know: revenue of $638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B, net income of $59.2B, operating income of $68.6B and cash and cash equivalents of $78.8B.
